Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this game. India Women have consolidated their place at the top of the points table but still have a game remaining. They will now face Thailand Women who have proved to be the dark horses so far in the competition. That game will be played on Monday, the 10th of October and will begin at 1 pm IST (7.30 am GMT). Our coverage though will begin sooner. Cheers!

Deepti Sharma (55 off 44 balls & 2 for 10) is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for her exploits with both bat and ball. She says that she is always prepared to play any role for the team as well as bowl. Mentions that she wanted to bowl in the right places and adds that it was difficult to bat on the wicket. Claims that a lot of hard work has gone into her batting and thanks her family and everyone else who has supported her. Ends by saying that they played really well and she is happy with their performance.

India Women skipper, Smriti Mandhana says that it was disappointing the way they played in the last game but is happy with the way they bounced back. This shows the signs of a good side and is proud of the girls. Mentions that it was a team performance and gives credit to Shafali Verma, Jemimah Rodrigues and even Deepti Sharma but reckons they could have got 10 or so more runs as well. Says that the bowlers did well and the plan was to keep bowling on good lines and lengths and make the batters make mistakes and everyone bowled really well.

Nigar Sultana, captain of Bangladesh Women admits that they didn’t bowl well in the Powerplay and credits the Indian batters for executing their plans well. Adds that they were unable to do well in the Powerplay with the bat either. Mentions that they did restrict the opposition towards the end but the first half cost them the game as the main bowlers didn’t do well. Claims that she wanted Rumana Ahmed to control the end overs therefore she was held back.
The Presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Smriti Mandhana, the stand-in captain for India Women won the toss and opted to put runs on the board. This proved to be a brilliant decision as the pitch had dried out and gotten good for batting. The opening pair of Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma put on a 96-run stand with the latter scoring a half-century. The two leg-spinners for Bangladesh Women, Fahima Khatun and Rumana Ahmed bowled well in the middle and Rumana even picked up three wickets. It was then Jemimah Rodrigues who showed her skills and took the Indian total over the 150-run mark. With a daunting target to chase down, the Bangladesh Women innings could never gain much momentum as even without losing wickets, the boundaries were hard to come by. A couple of batters in the top order did well but the Indian spin attack was too good and came up with the goods when it mattered most.

Bangladesh Women came into the contest with a bit of confidence as they were the team that defeated India Women twice in the previous Asia Cup but they could not repeat the feat as they were completely outplayed. Chasing 160 to win, they needed a fast start which they didn't get. They had wickets in hand but the required rate just kept on rising, which resulted in the batters playing false shots. A few wickets fell in the middle overs as both openers got out after getting a start. The skipper, Nigar Sultana tried her best but in the end, it was a bridge too far.

India Women had the runs on the board and given what happened in the last Asia Cup, it was basically a grudge match for them against the hosts. They bowled well inside the Powerplay but failed to pick up a wicket. In the middle overs though, their spinners showed good control and finally, the wickets fell which allowed India Women to maintain a stranglehold on the match. In the end, the bowlers were economical it was more than enough to get the win. Towards the end though, Shafali Verma picked up a couple of wickets to compliment her half-century and Deepti Sharma was sensational as well.

A comprehensive win then for India Women and they have managed to shrug off the defeat in their last game to affirm the position at the top of the points table which all but assures them of a semi-final berth as well. As for Bangladesh Women, they will have to win their remaining two games to make sure that they qualify for the semi-finals.
Low full toss on middle and leg, Salma Khatun clips this to deep mid-wicket for one. Bangladesh Women reach the 100-run mark but are well short of the target and have suffered a comprehensive defeat!
This is full as well and in line with the stumps, Salma Khatun clips this to wide long on for a brace.
Bowls this quicker and into the pads, Salma Khatun does not connect her flick and gets hit on the pads.
This is spinning in sharply from outside off, Salma Khatun gets beaten on the inside edge and the ball hits the pads.
A couple of runs. This is full and in line with the stumps, Salma Khatun heaves this towards deep square leg and they take a brace.
Salma Khatun walks in at number 9.

OUT! BOWLED! Another one bites the dust! Deepti Sharma comes in to bowl the final over and starts off with a good-length ball. This is served outside off and the ball turns in sharply and a long way as well. Lata Mondal looks to defend it off the front foot but the ball goes through the gap between bat and pad and goes on to hit the top of middle stump.
This is bowled full and outside off, Nahida Akter misses her cut shot as she gets beaten.
Nahida Akter walks in to bat now.

OUT! STUMPED! Shafali Verma has her career-best figures here! Some sharp work behind the wicket and another Bangladesh Women's batter departs timidly. Shafali Verma floats this full and outside off, Fahima Khatun looks to sweep but misses and Richa Ghosh whips the bails off in a flash. She is convinced that she has the stumping and the umpire refers this to the video umpire. Replays show that Fahima Khatun has dragged her back foot out of the crease and she is a goner! Shafali Verma looks thrilled and she caps what has been an outstanding all-round performance in this game.
Commentary.Howout: st Richa Ghosh b Shafali Verma

Commentary.Commentary: Is that stumped as well? Richa Ghosh is excited once again and reckons she has done the job. The decision is sent upstairs and we can see that Fahima Khatun has her back leg planted on the line and her bat is not put down in time either. The bails are whipped off in a flash and the decision is OUT.
This is wider outside off on a fuller length, Fahima Khatun knocks this to long off for one.
This is bowled full and in line with the of stump, Lata Mondal knocks this towards long on for a single.

OUT! STUMPED! Bangladesh Women losing wickets freely now in a quest to accelerate! Shafali Verma bowls a loopy delivery outside off, Nigar Sultana charges down the wicket and looks to heave the ball away but is beaten by the flight. Richa Ghosh does not make a mistake collecting the ball and whipping the bails off. The umpire goes upstairs and replays show that Nigar Sultana is well out of her crease. India Women rubbing salt to injury here.
Commentary.Howout: st Richa Ghosh b Shafali Verma

Commentary.Commentary: Is that a stumping? The wicket-keeper Richa Ghosh seems confident but the umpires have gone upstairs. Nigar Sultana steps way out of her crease as the ball is pushed wider. Ghosh collects the ball and whips off the bails and the replays show that Nigar Sultana was unable to get back in her crease. OUT!
This is flighted full and outside the off pole, Fahima Khatun drives the ball to long on for a single.
This is short and wide outside off, Nigar Sultana slaps this to deep point for a single.
Fahima Khatun is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! Renuka Singh bowls full and outside off, Ritu Moni looks to heave this over long on but does not connect well. The ball goes into the palms of Sneh Rana who takes a easy catch. Bangladesh Women lose their fourth wicket and are getting nowhere here.
Commentary.Howout: c Sneh Rana b Renuka Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Goes full this time and in line with the stumps, Ritu Moni works this towards long on for a single.
This is short and follows the batter to the leg side as she looks to make room. Ritu Moni knocks this to long on and gets a run.
This is outside off on a good length, Nigar Sultana works this to deep cover and takes a single.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Bangladesh Women! Renuka Singh bowls a short ball outside off, Nigar Sultana gets into position in a flash and pulls the ball towards deep square leg for four more runs.
FOUR! This is a good start to the over! Renuka Singh bowls this on a good length and outside the off pole, Nigar Sultana punches this towards deep point for four runs.
Renuka Singh (2-0-11-0) is back on.
Goes full and outside the off pole, Ritu Moni knocks this straight to the cover fielder.

DROPPED! A loopy delivery served outside the off pole, Ritu Moni reaches for this and hits the ball uppishly towards point. Sneh Rana dives to her left and gets both hands to the ball but is unable to hold on.
Goes full once again and outside off, Nigar Sultana knocks this to long on for one.
This is a fraction short and outside off, Ritu Moni pulls this to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
This is full as well and closer to the off pole, Ritu Moni looks to guide this but does not connect.
Flighted full and outside the off pole. Ritu Moni swings and is beaten.
FOUR! Another rare boundary from Bangladesh Women! Sneh Rana fires this outside off on a fuller length, Nigar Sultana shimmies down the wicket and thumps this to deep cover for four runs.
Sneh Rana flights this one outside off, Ritu Moni is down the wicket as she miscues her heave to deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is spinning into the pads on a fuller length, Nigar Sultana tucks this to square leg for another run.
This is a fraction short and outside off, Nigar Sultana slaps this towards deep cover-point.
Another flighted delivery served full and straight, Ritu Moni clips this to deep square leg for one.
Loopy delivery bowled full and in line with the stumps, Nigar Sultana sweeps this to deep backward square leg for a run.
Shafali Verma floats this full and outside off, Ritu Moni taps this firmly towards cover-point. Just 2 runs and a wicket in this over.
Floated up, full and outside off, this is hit away towards cover.
A loopy delivery, really slow and on off stump. Ritu Moni eases it onto the off side.
On the pads, this is worked away 'round the corner for a single.

OUT! RUN OUT! Deepti Sharma now does the job in the field as well. Shafali Verma drags it down the leg side and Rumana Ahmed tries to get inside the line, looking for the paddle. The ball though comes off the cue end of the bat and goes towards mid-wicket. The batters try to scamper through for the single but Deepti Sharma moves swiftly to her right and has a shy at the bowler's end. Sharma hits the bullseye and on the replays, we can see that Rumana Ahmed is well short. Ritu Moni makes her way out to the middle now.

Is that run-out? There is a direct hit at the non-striker's end and the umpire goes upstairs to check this. The replays show that the batter is well out of the crease and the decision has been given as OUT!
On a length and really slower through the air, on off. Nigar Sultana waits for it and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated up, full and on off stump, Rumana Ahmed hits it straight towards silly mid on.
Flighted delivery, around off and this is nudged away onto the leg side.
Rumana Ahmed makes her way out to the middle with her team staring down the barrel of defeat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sneh Rana takes the catch on the second attempt and India Women get their second wicket as well. Tossed up on off stump, Fargana Hoque dances down the track and looks for the big shot over long on. Hoque can't quite get underneath the ball and ends up hitting it straight down the throat of the fielder at long on. Rana almost fumbles the catch but manages to hold on as the ball comes off her shoulder and Deepti Sharma has done the trick for India Women.
Commentary.Howout: c Sneh Rana b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Around middle, this is pushed down to long on for one more.
Nicely flighted, full and on middle, Fargana Hoque digs it out on the off side for a single.

Nicely bowled! Deepti Sharma sees Fargana Hoque advancing and gives it a nice loop. The ball dips on the batter who manages to jam it out. Deepti Sharma throws the ball straight back towards the batter and Fargana Hoque isn't happy about it.
On a hard length and outside off, Nigar Sultana steps out but can only manage to tap it towards cover-point. Just 5 runs off that over, a good one for India Women.
Back of a length, over off stump and this is pulled away in front of mid-wicket for yet another single.
The quicker bumper now, over leg stump, Nigar Sultana manages to pull it away down to deep backward square leg for one.
Here comes the slower bumper now, bowled outside off and Nigar Sultana tries to cut it but is undone by the lack of pace.
An attempted slower yorker, ends up being a dipping full toss. Fargana Hoque thrashes it away through the cover region for just a single.
Full and outside off, this is firmly driven through extra cover for a couple of runs.
This is in line with the stumps on a fuller length, Nigar Sultana gets a stride forward and blocks the ball back to towards the bowler. 10 runs from this over.
This is bowled short and angled into the batter, Nigar Sultana rocks back and taps this towards mid on.

FOUR! Second boundary of the over! Rajeshwari Gayakwad flights this full and outside the off pole, Nigar Sultana shimmies down the wicket and lofts the ball over the mid off fielder, and finds the boundary for four more runs.
Fires this one full and outside off, Nigar Sultana taps this towards slip.
This is looped full and outside off, Nigar Sultana reaches for this and heaves the ball towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! This is a welcome boundary for Bangladesh Women! Rajeshwari Gayakwad floats this full and in line with the stumps, Nigar Sultana sweeps this to deep backward square leg for four runs.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes back on to replace Sneh Rana.
This is on a fuller length outside off, Nigar Sultana strokes this to deep cover and takes one to keep strike.
Goes full and angles this into the stumps, Nigar Sultana works this towards point and looks for a single that is not there.
This is bowled on a good length and outside off, Nigar Sultana looks to heave this to the leg side but gets beaten.
Bowls this with pace off on a good length and outside the off stump, Fargana Hoque gets her front foot out of the way and slap this to deep cover for a single.
Pooja Vastrakar continues bowling on a good length and outside the off pole, Nigar Sultana guides this to deep backward point for a run.
This is on a good length and outside off, Nigar Sultana feels for the ball but is beaten.
Pooja Vastrakar (1-0-9-0) is back on.
This is bowled full and in line with the stumps, Fargana Hoque shimmies down the wicket but ends up yorking herself.
Sneh Rana bowls this quicker outside off on a fuller length, Fargana Hoque looks to play this late but misses.
Continues bowling full and outside off, Nigar Sultana knocks this towards point for one.
This is full as well and outside off, Fargana Hoque strokes this towards deep cover for a single
Sneh Rana flights this full and outside off, Nigar Sultana pushes at this and gets an inside edge towards square leg to get off the mark with a single.

Drinks break! Bangladesh Women had managed to preserve their wickets but were unable to score runs freely. The pressure had been building and that has resulted in the wicket before the break. The India Women's bowlers lacked the penetration but have bowled with discipline to keep tabs on the scoring rate. Also, Nigar Sultana, the Bangladesh Women skipper walks in to bat at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Smriti Mandhana takes a sharp catch and Murshida Khatun is sent back to the hut. Sneh Rana tosses it up outside off. Khatun steps down the track, under pressure and needing a boundary. Khatun doesn't quite get to the pitch of the ball and ends up driving it uppishly towards short extra cover. The stand-in skipper for India Women takes a good catch around her face and the partnership is finally broken. 115 needed now off 65 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Smriti Mandhana b Sneh Rana

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker one, darted in outside off and Fargana Hoque is beaten all ends up.
This is outside off yet again, Murshida Khatun uses her feet and drives it towards sweeper cover for only a single.
Quicker and flatter, outside off. Another play and a miss by Murshida Khatun and the pressure keeps on mounting.
Switches to around the wicket now and serves a short and wide one. Murshida Khatun misses out as she fails to cut it away.
Nagging length, pushed wide of the off stump, Fargana Hoque waits for it and slaps it square of the wicket towards sweeper cover for one.
Flighted, on a length and around off, this is punched away towards mid off.
Shafali Verma to have a bowl now.
Bowls an entire over of short deliveries, this one outside off. Murshida Khatun looks to slash at this but is beaten.
This is outside the off pole on a shorter length once again. Murshida Khatun cuts this late towards deep backward point for a brace.
Keeps bowling short and in line with the stumps, Fargana Hoque pulls this to deep square leg for one.
Continues bowling short and outside the off pole, Fargana Hoque cuts this late towards third man and takes a couple of runs.
This is short as well and spinning into the batter from outside off, Fargana Hoque looks to cut this late but gets an edge just short of slip.
Sneh Rana begins with a short delivery outside off, Murshida Khatun cuts this uppishly towards point and the ball falls just short. They take a run as the ball is not collected cleanly.
Sneh Rana comes into the attack now.
A loopy delivery bowled full and outside off, Fargana Hoque under cuts this into the pitch towards the slip fielder.
This is fired into the stumps on a fuller length, Murshida Khatun flicks this towards deep square leg and takes a single.
This is short and outside off, Fargana Hoque slaps this to deep cover and takes one.
Angled into the pads on a fuller length, Murshida Khatun clips thsi ball to deep mid-wicket for a run.
This is in line with the stumps on a shorter length, Murshida Khatun taps this back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Bangladesh Women are on the charge now! Rajeshwari Gayakwad floats this full and outside off, Murshida Khatun gets a stride forward and strokes it wide of mid off for a boundary.

FOUR! Nicely done! Good length, outside off, Fargana Hoque waits for it and just guides it past the diving fielder at short third man for a boundary. At the end of the Powerplay, Bangladesh Women are 30/0!
Play and a miss! Length ball, well outside off, Fargana Hoque looks to slap it away but fails to connect yet again.
Full and wide, bowled at a good pace. Fargana Hoque looks to thrash it away but misses the ball.
Missed opportunity! Short and wide, cut away hard but straight to the point fielder.
FOUR! Short again and over middle, Fargana Hoque gets in position quickly and muscles it away behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Pooja Vastrakar comes into the attack and starts off with a short ball over leg stump. Murshida Khatun pulls it away towards deep square leg for just a single.
Nagging length, around off, Fargana Hoque chops it towards first slip.
This is dragged down around middle, Fargana Hoque fails to take advantage and pulls it straight towards mid on.

Confusion all-around! Shorter delivery, on the pads and this is pulled away past square leg. The batters take a single but while going for the second run there is a bit of a mix-up. They do go for it and the throw at the bowler's end is well wide. In the end, they get three runs.
Loopy delivery, on off stump and Murshida Khatun just pushes it towards mid off.
Flighted, on off and this is dragged towards mid-wicket for a single.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad now comes into the attack and starts off with a full ball on middle. Fargana Hoque drives it towards mid on.
Full and at the stumps, pushed out towards mid off for a quick single. Excellent running.
FOUR! Fargana Hoque gets one away and it was much-needed for Bangladesh Women. Pitched up on off stump, Hoque heaves it towards wide long on and the ball goes one-bounce into the fence.
Renuka Singh goes fuller and angles this one into the pads. Fargana Hoque looks to flick but falls over a bit and gets hit on the pads.
Fullish length, angling in from around off, Fargana Hoque drives it towards extra cover.

Murshida Khatun looks to make a bit of room and Renuka Singh serves a yorker-length delivery on off stump. Khatun ends up getting an inside edge towards short mid-wicket and the batters steal a quick single as well.
Renuka Singh comes from around the wicket and angles it on a length and into middle stump. Murshida Khatun backs away and drives it straight towards short cover.
Short and outside off, Murshida Khatun stays back and cuts it past the point fielder for one more.
On the shorter side this time and Fargana Hoque plays it off the back foot towards mid-wicket for a run.
Full and on middle, pushed to the right of the bowler.
Lucky! Deepti Sharma serves another loopy delivery outside off, Murshida Khatun reaches out and ends up chipping it. The ball goes just over the cover region and a single is taken.
Flighted, well outside off and turning away, Murshida Khatun looks to drive at it but is well beaten.
Nicely looped up, around off, this is pushed away onto the off side for a single.
FOUR! Finally, Murshida Khatun gets one away and gets off the mark. Just a fraction short and on middle, Khatun heaves it away over the fielder at mid-wicket and finds the fence.
Murshida Khatun finding it difficult to get off strike here. Top of the off stump line and Khatun mistimes the heave towards silly mid off.
Fuller length, on off stump, Murshida Khatun plays it with a straight bat and towards mid off.
Banged in short this time, around off and this is pulled away to the right of deep mid-wicket for a single.

Renuka Singh goes wide of the crease and angles this one in at the stumps. Fargana Hoque falls over as she looks to flick it away and gets hit on the pads. Half an appeal for lbw but it is going down leg.
Renuka Singh starts off with a good-length delivery that nips back in off the deck sharply. This is around off and Fargana Hoque just about manages to keep it out.
Renuka Singh will share the attack and bowl from the other end.
A tidy first over then from Deepti Sharma, just 2 runs off it. This is pushed wider and Murshida Khatun taps it away towards cover.
Nicely bowled! Good loop on that one, bowled outside off and Murshida Khatun looks to drive. The ball goes off the outside edge and towards backward point.
WIDE! Flighted, well outside off and turning further away. Murshida Khatun can't reach it and a wide is called.
Should have been put away! Short and wide outside off, Murshida Khatun cuts it off the back foot but finds the fielder at point.
Bangladesh Women are underway! This is flatter and goes straight on, Fargana Hoque edges it down with soft hands towards the gully region and scampers through for a single.
Slower through the air, on middle and leg and turning into the right-hander. Fargana Hoque looks to block but misses and gets pinged on the pads.
Deepti Sharma starts off with a loopy delivery, full and on middle and leg. Fargana Hoque works it away onto the leg side.
